description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and known for locally sourced ingredients including Canadian beef, BC chicken, and BC-grown Kennebec potato fries. The Richmond (Ackroyd) location is a full-service family restaurant offering dine-in with a patio, takeout, and delivery. It is a reliable sit-down meal option for cyclists passing through central Richmond along the Number 3 Road corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 16m; rack at 44m; rack at 53m; rack at 65m; rack at 76m; stands at 91m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for the Richmond (Ackroyd) location confirms the business is active, listing amenities explicitly as Patio, Dine in, Delivery, Online Ordering, and Take Out with SkipTheDishes/DoorDash/Uber Eats integrations. Phone (604-273-3699) and email (unit139@whitespot.ca) match OSM exactly, but the postal code differs (OSM: V6X 2E1 vs website: V6X 3K2). No bike-specific amenities, Wi-Fi, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM has V6X 2E1, but the business website shows V6X 3K2. Website value used as primary source for address field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible full-service restaurant in a chain with many BC locations. A reliable meal stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.

wow_evidence: BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928
